method: Each path is the average jet stream wind about 10 km up (the 250 hPa level) over a group of ski seasons, November to April, from ERA5, sampled once a day. The line follows the fastest average wind; the band is where the wind stays within 5 percent of that, at most 5 degrees of latitude either side. El Niño and La Niña winters follow NOAA's Relative Oceanic Niño Index since 1979/80.
